static_traits.name: Lin Sijie
static_traits.social_status: Having a few close friends who know of their predicament, but rarely proactively seeking help; avoiding gatherings due to Social anxiety, finding it hard to start conversations, affecting building and maintaining intimate relationships and professional networks
static_traits.medical_history: Diagnosed with mild OCD during college, accompanied by Anxiety; never received specialized treatment for Social anxiety or OCD; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to notice and describe one's own negative thinking (such as 'everyone is judging me' 'I am clumsy'); Good cooperation, open to exploring cognitive restructuring; strong tendency toward self-criticism

basic_info.main_problem: In social situations, will 'freeze', feels oneself to be very clumsy, affecting interaction and relationships with others.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to feel comfortable in Social situations, no longer bound by Anxiety, and to build genuine connections on personal and professional levels and smoothly carry out networking and client interactions.
growth_experiences: Social anxiety started appearing in college and mild OCD was diagnosed; symptoms worsened in the past two years, causing 'freezing' in group settings or When meeting new friends, avoiding Social gatherings and difficulty initiating conversations; never received treatment for Social anxiety or OCD; although Work performance is Good, professional networking and client interactions have suffered, and forming intimate relationships is difficult.

core_beliefs: Others will judge and negate me

special_situations.event: Failing to express oneself well when introducing oneself at a business social/networking event
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot perform fluently and near-perfectly in public, others will think I am incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Speaking less, leaving as soon as possible, and avoiding similar activities afterward

special_situations.event: In group settings or when meeting new clients/strangers, tension and 'freezing' appear
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot perform at ease immediately, it proves I am not suited for socializing, I am just a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Leaving early and avoiding starting conversations to reduce the chance of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never be able to handle these situations

special_situations.event: Being triggered by OCD in social interactions, excessively worrying that tiny flaws will be noticed by others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any small mistake will be magnified and attract negative evaluation
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive Self-monitoring and Over-preparation, deliberately controlling words and actions or avoiding exposing oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I made a small mistake; everyone will only see these flaws and think I am unprofessional

special_situations.event: When recalling past times when several social conversations went smoothly
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If it is not excellent every time, those positive experiences do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating positive experiences, continuing to define oneself with negative labels
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Those successes were just accidents, not proof that I can do well

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and build genuine connections
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged and negated by others, worrying about being seen as incompetent or clumsy
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being negated by avoiding group settings and Reinforcing Self-monitoring
Not seeking help from others to avoid becoming a burden

object_relations.object_representation: Others/groups who are critical and ready to judge me at any time

object_relations.self_representation: An individual who should not trouble others
object_relations.object_representation: Friends / others who may be 'dragged down' by her

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to introduce self in a group setting or being watched by many people
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others are scrutinizing and negating me (projecting inner harsh judgment onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a defensive tone and absolutist wording (such as 'everyone thinks...'), shortening interactions, ending conversations quickly or finding reasons to leave.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of seeking help from friends or when others offer support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If seeking help becomes a burden, others may be unwilling or may look down on me
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Refusing others' help in a tactful but firm way, repeatedly emphasizing 'I should not trouble others', avoiding further discussion of specific ways of support.

manifestations: In social settings she 'freezes' and avoids gatherings, finds it hard to initiate conversation, and often leaves social settings alone
Although close friends know of their predicament, not proactively seeking their help to avoid becoming a burden
outcomes: Reduced interpersonal connection; difficulty forming intimate relationships
Limited professional network; interaction with clients affected

contact_model.definition: The individual has unhealthy self-Reflection and excessive self-restriction, self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: High self-consciousness and tension in socializing, paying excessive attention to whether minor mistakes are noticed by others
Deliberately controls words and actions to avoid mistakes, leading to 'freezing' and difficulty speaking

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Believing 'everyone is judging me' 'they think I am incompetent', attributing inner critical experiences to others outside

contact_model.definition: The individual turns libidinal energy directed outward back onto the self, restraining the impulse to seek others to do things for them.
manifestations: Not seeking support from friends, choosing to bear Anxiety and OCD distress alone
Repressing help-seeking behavior on the grounds of 'should not trouble others'

positive_force: Proactively seeking psychological counseling and change, having self-awareness (able to identify and willing to challenge negative thinking)
Work performance stable, with professional competence and a sense of responsibility
Has several close friends who know his predicament, a potential support resource
Has had a few experiences of smooth social conversations, which can serve as positive references
negative_force: Tending to avoid and leave early in group settings and When meeting new friends, maintaining short-term security but perpetuating the problem
Having cognitive biases such as mind-reading, overgeneralization, mental filtering, and negating the positive
Mild OCD making them overly focus on tiny mistakes, further worsening Social anxiety
Self-labeling ('clumsy' 'incompetent') and negating positive experiences, weakening Self-efficacy
Worrying about becoming a burden and thus not seeking support, leaving resources unactivated

target_behavior.behavior: In social settings, 'freezes' and avoids interaction
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and overgeneralizing cognition (fearing total negation), plus OCD-induced excessive attention to tiny mistakes, Reinforcing Self-monitoring and tension
target_behavior.function: Avoiding judgment and negation to lower immediate Anxiety, gaining short-term security
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged Interpersonal relationships and professional networks, affected client interactions; feeling Loneliness and Decreased sense of self-worth

target_behavior.behavior: Not seeking help and support from friends or others
antecedent: When thinking about seeking support from others
When friends know their plight and offer help
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries about becoming a burden and being looked down on; magnifies potential negative outcomes to avoid seeking help
target_behavior.function: Avoids guilt and possible rejection, maintaining a sense of control over relationship risks
target_behavior.consequence: Support system unactivated, problem maintained and Increased sense of isolation
